SELECT prediction_decisions.id AS prediction_decisions_id, prediction_decisions.question AS prediction_decisions_question, prediction_decisions.category AS prediction_decisions_category, prediction_decisions.decision_value AS prediction_decisions_decision_value, prediction_decisions.ratification_state AS prediction_decisions_ratification_state, prediction_decisions.data_origin AS prediction_decisions_data_origin, prediction_decisions.response_type AS prediction_decisions_response_type, prediction_decisions.question_embedding AS prediction_decisions_question_embedding, prediction_decisions.created_at AS prediction_decisions_created_at, prediction_decisions.owner_user_id AS prediction_decisions_owner_user_id, prediction_decisions.answer_source AS prediction_decisions_answer_source, prediction_decisions.question_embedding <#> %(question_embedding_1)s AS distance 
FROM prediction_decisions ORDER BY (prediction_decisions.question_embedding <#> %(question_embedding_1)s) ASC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s

SELECT prediction_decisions.id AS prediction_decisions_id, prediction_decisions.question AS prediction_decisions_question, prediction_decisions.category AS prediction_decisions_category, prediction_decisions.decision_value AS prediction_decisions_decision_value, prediction_decisions.ratification_state AS prediction_decisions_ratification_state, prediction_decisions.data_origin AS prediction_decisions_data_origin, prediction_decisions.response_type AS prediction_decisions_response_type, prediction_decisions.question_embedding AS prediction_decisions_question_embedding, prediction_decisions.created_at AS prediction_decisions_created_at, prediction_decisions.owner_user_id AS prediction_decisions_owner_user_id, prediction_decisions.answer_source AS prediction_decisions_answer_source, prediction_decisions.question_embedding <#> %(question_embedding_1)s AS distance
